item.title: Dune Magic: The Gathering Crossover Officially Confirmed After Major Leak
item.description: The spice must flow, and so must the Secret Lair drops. After several days of leaks circulating online , Dune is officially crossing over with Magic: The Gathering , with Wizards of the Coast teasing the collaboration through the official MTG Secret Lair account.

item.title: 8 Biggest Snubs in the 2026 Game Awards Nominations
item.description: The Game Awards has announced its official list of nominees for this year’s prizes. Among the nominees are plenty of obvious contenders, such as Grand Theft Auto 6 , Resident Evil Requiem , and The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time . There was stiff competition across several categories, meaning that some worthy games — and Polygon favorites — didn’t make the shortlist for certain prizes. These are the biggest TGA nomination snubs of 2026.

item.title: The Mighty Nein Season 2 Officially Has Fans Worried About One Major Plot Change
item.description: The Mighty Nein season 2 is officially set to return to our TV screens in March 2027. And while Critical Role fans may be a little put out by Amazon's new episode schedule, the season’s content has Critters excited for what’s to come from our band of lovable misfits.

item.title: New 'Pokémon' TCG Lucario Set Leaks In Stores Months Before Official Release
item.description: The Pokémon Trading Card Game's latest set, Delta Reign , just came out a couple of weeks ago in early November. The next set, Flowing Fists, isn't scheduled to drop for another few months. Most people haven't seen Delta Reign boxes in stores yet, never mind the recent Pokémon 30th Anniversary set . Despite all of this, real people have apparently already acquired packs of Flowing Fist. Heck, some people have already pulled the next set's chase card — which hasn't even been formally revealed yet!

item.title: Pokémon Go’s Most Cursed Crossover Officially Revealed
item.description: Pokémon Go has had its share of crossovers with other brands over the past decade, including The North Face x Gucci, Major League Baseball, and Lego. The mobile gotta-catch-'em-all game's latest will bring a new critter to the game, one known to strike fear in the hearts of mobile users.

item.title: DMZ key and locations in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: There are loads of DMZ keys in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . Used to open both locked containers and locked doors, keys are your fast-track to getting your hands on some of the best loot the extraction mode has to offer. However, when you receive a key, you're only given a brief description of where to use it, so we're going to outline where you can use every key the game has to offer.

item.title: All active Aniimo codes list
item.description: Aniimo codes give you bonus level-up materials and other currency, including glimmer. It might not have a traditional gacha system, but these freebies come in handy anyway. For one thing, you need a lot of level-up materials once you start raising your aniimo army. Plus you can use Glimmer in the in-game shop to buy useful items or the currency you can exchange for Sparkling Cubes to use on eggs. If none of that takes your fancy, you can always just keep it for later, too.

item.title: GTA 6's Rumored Lucia Actor Confirmed for Cast by Game Awards Nomination
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 received several nominations at The Game Awards , which were revealed on Tuesday. While GTA 6 's nomination for Game of the Year wasn't too surprising, another nomination immediately stood out.

item.title: GTA 6 Officially Becomes Clear Game Awards 2026 Frontrunner
item.description: The Game Awards revealed its full list of nominees today , and things went as many expected : Grand Theft Auto 6 is the clear frontrunner in the 2026 Game of the Year race. GTA 6 scored an impressive eight nominations, including Best Narrative, Best Action/Adventure Game, Best Game Direction, and Game of the Year. Control: Resonant is tied for second with six nominations, earning nods for Game of the Year, Best Narrative, and Best Game Direction. Resident Evil Requiem also has six nominations, including for Game of the Year .

item.title: The Game Awards Announces Game of the Year 2026 Nominees
item.description: After months of anticipation and constant speculation , we finally know what games will duke it out for the top prize at The Game Awards 2026 . Organizers for the biggest night in gaming announced this year's nominees for Game of the Year , and all the other categories, during a livestream on Tuesday, Nov. 17.
